百回.name: Century
百回.desc: Clear songs 100 times in total (repeats of the same song count).

新曲嘗鮮.name: Fresh Tracks
新曲嘗鮮.desc: Clear 5 newly released songs (catching up later counts too).

七十一夜.name: Seventy-One Nights
七十一夜.reward: Title “Seventy-One Nights” + Limited Background “My Star Map” (a night sky drawn from your own clear records) + Limited Nameplate “Star Trail”

普通入門.name: Through the Door
普通入門.desc: Clear your first song on Normal.

初探困難.name: Into the Wind
初探困難.desc: Clear your first song on Hard.

換個難度.name: Variation
換個難度.desc: Clear the same song on 2 different difficulties.

三光初現.name: Triple Light
三光初現.desc: Clear your first song on Expert (three orbs).

五階遊歷.name: Five Realms
五階遊歷.desc: Clear 5 songs on each of the 5 difficulties.

五弦俱全.name: Fully Strung
五弦俱全.desc: Clear the same song on all 5 difficulties.

拾級而上.name: Step by Step
拾級而上.desc: Get an A or better on the same song on 3 different difficulties.

越級者.name: Leapfrog
越級者.desc: Clear a song you have never cleared before on Hard or higher the first time.

五線全能.name: Full Staff
五線全能.desc: Clear 20 songs on each of the 5 difficulties.

第一顆星.name: First Star
第一顆星.desc: Clear 3 songs in the same constellation.

半座.name: Half-Lit
半座.desc: Clear at least half the songs in any constellation.

觀星.name: Stargazer
觀星.desc: Open 5 unknown constellations that still show “???” on the Night Sky map.

古老旋律座完成.name: Old Melodies Complete
古老旋律座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Old Melodies constellation.

巴洛克座完成.name: Baroque Complete
巴洛克座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Baroque constellation.

古典座完成.name: Classical Complete
古典座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Classical constellation.

浪漫座完成.name: Romantic Complete
浪漫座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Romantic constellation.

歌劇與名歌座完成.name: Opera & Song Complete
歌劇與名歌座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Opera & Song constellation.

晚浪漫與印象座完成.name: Late Romantic Complete
晚浪漫與印象座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Late Romantic constellation.

聖誕座完成.name: Christmas Complete
聖誕座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Christmas constellation.

聖詩座完成.name: Hymns Complete
聖詩座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Hymns constellation.

童謠民謠座完成.name: Nursery & Folk Complete
童謠民謠座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Nursery & Folk constellation.

霓虹座完成.name: Neon Complete
霓虹座完成.desc: Clear every song in the Neon constellation.

初聲.name: First Voice
初聲.desc: Clear all 71 songs on Beginner → the bonus constellation “First Voice · Aquila” emerges, unlocking 5 bonus songs.

鄉謠.name: Folk Roads
鄉謠.desc: Clear all 71 songs on Easy → the bonus constellation “Folk Roads · Gemini” emerges, unlocking 5 bonus songs.

墨上聽潮.name: Ink Tides
墨上聽潮.desc: Clear every song in the Romantic constellation on Hard or higher.
墨上聽潮.reward: Limited Ink Wash theme set, all 5 items + Ink Wash share card frame + Title “Ink Tides”

摘星者.name: Star Catcher
摘星者.desc: Clear every song in all 10 constellations on Normal or higher.
摘星者.reward: Title “Star Catcher” + Limited Golden Constellation theme set, all items + Gold share card frame

名曲.name: Masterpieces
名曲.desc: Clear all 71 songs on Normal → the bonus constellation “Masterpieces · Pegasus” emerges, unlocking 5 bonus songs.

疾風.name: Gale
疾風.desc: Clear all 71 songs on Hard → the bonus constellation “Gale · Sagittarius” emerges, unlocking 5 bonus songs.

超新星.name: Supernova
超新星.desc: Clear every song in any one regular constellation on Expert.
超新星.reward: Title “Supernova” + Limited Orb “Star Core” + Limited Hit Effect “Supernova”

炫技.name: Virtuoso
炫技.desc: Clear all 71 songs on Expert → the bonus constellation “Virtuoso · Canis Major” emerges, unlocking 3 bonus songs.

至高.name: Summit
至高.desc: Get rank S on all 71 songs on Expert → the bonus constellation “Summit · Southern Cross” emerges, unlocking 2 bonus songs.

拾遺.name: Gleaner
拾遺.desc: Clear all 25 bonus songs (each on its own difficulty).

天籟.name: Celestial Voice
天籟.desc: Complete all 10 regular constellations and reveal all 6 bonus constellations (First Voice, Folk Roads, Masterpieces, Gale, Virtuoso and Summit all achieved) → the golden Musical Note appears.
天籟.reward: Title “Celestial Voice” + Limited Legendary Avatar “Star Crown” (with a flowing halo ring)

起步 A.name: Making the Grade
起步 A.desc: Get an A or better on any song.

第一顆 S.name: Star in Hand
第一顆 S.desc: Get rank S on any song.

五顆 A.name: Honor Roll
五顆 A.desc: Earn 5 A-or-better ranks in total (each difficulty counts separately).

九成準.name: Sharpshooter
九成準.desc: Reach 95% accuracy or higher on any song.

九成九.name: Nearly Flawless
九成九.desc: Reach 99% accuracy or higher on any song.

零誤差.name: Flawless Song
零誤差.desc: Reach 100% accuracy on any song (any difficulty).

拾星.name: Star Gatherer
拾星.desc: Earn 10 S ranks in total (each difficulty counts separately).

百發百中.name: Bullseye
百發百中.desc: Land 100 Perfect judgments in a row in one song.

分毫不差.name: Spot On
分毫不差.desc: Reach 100% accuracy on any song on Hard or higher.
分毫不差.reward: Title “Spot On” + Limited Hit Effect “Precision Dial”

一座皆 S.name: Brilliant Stars
一座皆 S.desc: Get rank S on every song in a constellation on the same difficulty.

絕對音準.name: Perfect Pitch
絕對音準.desc: Reach 100% accuracy on 10 songs on Hard or higher.

不朽樂章.name: Immortal Opus
不朽樂章.desc: Get rank S on all 71 songs on Hard or higher.
不朽樂章.reward: Title “Immortal Opus” + Legendary Avatar “Laurel” + Limited Nameplate “Immortal” (a flowing music staff)

二十連.name: Pearl Chain
二十連.desc: Reach a 20 combo in one song.

五十連.name: Pearl Strand
五十連.desc: Reach a 50 combo in one song.

一氣呵成.name: In One Breath
一氣呵成.desc: Get a full combo on any song (no misses).

星光初拾.name: Starlight Catch
星光初拾.desc: Catch a whole Star Time segment for the first time.

彩虹橋.name: Rainbow Bridge
彩虹橋.desc: Reach a 100 combo in one song (the orb turns rainbow).

十全.name: Perfect Ten
十全.desc: Get a full combo on 10 songs in total.

長虹.name: Rainbow Arc
長虹.desc: Reach a 200 combo in one song.

全連擊大師.name: Full Combo Master
全連擊大師.desc: Get a full combo on 10 songs on Hard or higher.

流星雨.name: Meteor Shower
流星雨.desc: Get a full combo on 30 songs in total.

金色時刻.name: Golden Hour
金色時刻.desc: Break a 100 combo during Star Time.

星光全收.name: Galaxy Keeper
星光全收.desc: Catch every Star Time segment in a song without a miss.

千鈞一線.name: Sunpiercer
千鈞一線.desc: Reach a 400 combo in one song.

三光無缺.name: Flawless Trio
三光無缺.desc: Get a full combo on 10 songs on Expert.

同台.name: Shared Stage
同台.desc: Finish 1 match with 4 or more players.

再會.name: Rematch
再會.desc: Play 3 matches against the same player.

初露鋒芒.name: Sharp Debut
初露鋒芒.desc: Win 10 matches (beating at least 3 different opponents).

知音.name: Kindred Spirit
知音.desc: End a match with exactly the same accuracy as your opponent (both of you clear the song).

最終樂章.name: Finale Comeback
最終樂章.desc: Go from last place to first in the final 10% of a match.

凱旋曲.name: Triumphal March
凱旋曲.desc: Win 50 matches (beating at least 10 different opponents).

八方之冠.name: Crown of Eight
八方之冠.desc: Take 1st place in a room that started with 8 players (at least 6 valid opponents).

全場最佳.name: Star of the Show
全場最佳.desc: Take 1st place with a full combo in a room that started with 8 players (at least 6 valid opponents).

常勝樂章.name: Winning Refrain
常勝樂章.desc: Win 200 matches (beating at least 20 different opponents).

打招呼.name: Friendly Nod
打招呼.desc: Send your first emote during a match.

開張.name: Downbeat
開張.desc: Host and start 1 match in a private room.

邀約.name: Invitation
邀約.desc: Invite a friend to a room once.

引路人.name: Pathfinder
引路人.desc: A player you sent a friend request to had no records when you became friends, and later cleared their first song.

指揮家.name: Conductor
指揮家.desc: Host and start 30 matches in a private room.

八音和鳴.name: Full Octet
八音和鳴.desc: Fill an 8-player room with 7 friends and finish 1 match.

合奏團.name: Ensemble
合奏團.desc: Finish 10 matches in a room of 4 or more players (at least 2 friends in the room).

換新裝.name: New Look
換新裝.desc: Change any cosmetic for the first time.

初得.name: First Reward
初得.desc: Equip an achievement reward item for the first time.

署名.name: Signature
署名.desc: Equip a title for the first time.

試穿.name: Window Shopper
試穿.desc: Preview 5 different items in the Shop.

戰利品.name: Spoils
戰利品.desc: Clear 10 songs with an achievement reward item equipped.

混搭.name: Mix & Match
混搭.desc: Clear 1 song with an orb, trail and hit effect from three different themes.

秘藏.name: Hidden Trove
秘藏.desc: Own 5 achievement reward items marked “Limited” (constellation badge avatars don’t count).

仰望.name: Look Up
仰望.desc: Open the Night Sky map for the first time.

調音台.name: Mixing Desk
調音台.desc: Adjust the volume or display settings for the first time.

翻閱.name: Page Turner
翻閱.desc: Open all 10 pages of the Achievements screen.

溫故.name: Revisited
溫故.desc: Replay a song you haven’t played in 30 days or more and clear it.

遍聽.name: Sky Wanderer
遍聽.desc: Start playing all 71 songs at least once.

喘口氣.name: Intermission
喘口氣.desc: Hint: “Take a break” → pause during a game, resume, and still clear the song.

出師不利.name: Rough Start
出師不利.desc: Hint: “It’s okay” → miss the very first judgment and still clear the song.

心中有歌.name: Inner Song
心中有歌.desc: Hint: “Listen with your heart” → clear 1 song with the music volume turned off.

一線生機.name: Lifeline
一線生機.desc: Hint: “That was close” → clear a song with less than 10% life left.

屢敗屢戰.name: Fight On
屢敗屢戰.desc: Hint: “Failure is the mother of…” → clear a song after failing it 5 times on the same difficulty.

百折不撓.name: Unyielding
百折不撓.desc: Hint: “One more time” → attempt the same song 30 times in total.

完美開場.name: Perfect Opening
完美開場.desc: Hint: “A good start” → get Perfect on the first 50 judgments of a song.

完美收尾.name: Perfect Finish
完美收尾.desc: Hint: “Afterglow” → get Perfect on the last 50 judgments of a song.

不滅.name: Against the Odds
不滅.desc: Hint: “It isn’t over yet” → drop to just 1 life point at some moment, and still finish with an A or better.
